product.name: Intra
product.tagline: The trusted business layer for AI-agent commerce
product.thesis: Makes a real, WhatsApp-run, non-API business safely callable by any AI agent — without the business building anything, and without either side losing human control of the money or the final order.
product.mvpScope: Campus flyer printing for Nigerian students and small businesses. One vertical only.
product.hackathon: Celo 'Agents at Work' — primary track Real World Adoption; secondary Best Stablecoin Adoption, AskBots CLI Growth, Judges' Favorite
nonGoals: general shopping agent or public marketplace
custody, escrow, remittances, swaps, automatic final payments
requiring suppliers to run MCP/API infrastructure
native mobile app or WhatsApp bot
fake payment receipts or simulated x402 success
any public reliability / reputation / on-time score

stack.forms: react-hook-form on RequestForm + OnboardingForm; raw FormData / useState elsewhere
stack.chain: viem 2.56 (client-lazy-imported) — only chain library; no ethers/wagmi

every enum → a plain label (taskStatusLabel, routeStatusLabel, eventLabel, outcomeCopy, requestErrorCopy, describeTaskException, PRICING_MODEL_COPY, PROOFLINE_*_LABEL)
idempotency-key generation per write; the /v1 quote folds sha256(X-PAYMENT) into the scope
commitment creation + handover-secret issuance at approval (local + transactional)
the WhatsApp orderMessage templating (generated, never sent) + regeneration on decision / revision
MiniPay: intent minting from the commitment, FX rate fetch + lock, ERC-20 transfer construction, chain switch, receipt verification, polling, invalidation on a terms change
x402 failure taxonomy → 3-5 buyer-facing Callouts (never the codes); malformed config degrades to UNAVAILABLE, never a 500
notify() → specsForEvent → rows + dedupe + level classification + fire-and-forget push
listBuyerWork: group every task into 5 plain buckets with a headline + an action pill
route freshness: 14-day window, staleAfter computation, routeIsQuoteReady gate, capability-doc availability verdict
evidence: aggregate COUNTs from existing tables on read; classify real vs demo; integration-status checks
after() keeps the agent run + payment verifier alive past the HTTP response
the service worker: /api/* network-only; static cache-first; navigations network-first → /offline; install-and-wait updates
analytics: no-op-safe wrappers; the adapter swallows every failure; a thrown analytics arm cannot fail a commerce action

flows.whoPaysWhom: the buyer's agent → a paid information service
flows.purpose: pay for current information; distinct from the order price (BR-004)
flows.cap: $0.05/task, server-enforced (not an env var); default fee $0.02
flows.currentState: ALWAYS UNAVAILABLE on the buyer web flow (submitTask writes an UNAVAILABLE row); the /v1 quote endpoint returns 503 for paid routes without X402_API_KEY
flows.settledRule: a real official-facilitator verification + a real mainnet tx hash; a SETTLED row is append-only and never edited

failureTaxonomy.FAILED: bad auth (402, retryable by the agent)
failureTaxonomy.UNAVAILABLE: no key / bad config / facilitator unreachable (503, not the agent's fault)

flows.buyerSurface: TaskPage PaymentReceipt — label + an honesty Callout ('Intra never fabricates a payment'); PROBLEM: on the rare SETTLED path it leaks attributionTag, atomic amounts, CAIP-2 ids

flows.whoPaysWhom: the buyer → the business, on-chain USDC
flows.custody: NON-CUSTODIAL — wallet → business payout address direct; Intra never touches the funds
flows.availability: only when task.status === HANDOFF_READY (commercial terms already approved) AND NETWORK_ENV=production; additive — the WhatsApp handoff is always the fallback
flows.asset: USDC only (6 dp), address in adapter/networks.ts
flows.fx: NGN quotes + a real NGN→USD reference rate (NGN_USD_RATE_URL, default keyless open.er-api.com), LOCKED into the intent with its source + timestamp; source down → 503, never a guessed rate
flows.intentImmutable: recipient / amount / rate frozen at creation; a terms change invalidates the intent and needs a fresh human approval
flows.clientSubmits: ONLY a tx hash — the server never trusts a client 'success'
flows.confirmedRule: verifyOrderPayment reads the real Celo receipt: chain + success + USDC 'to' + a single Transfer to the recipient for the exact amount all match; payerAddress recorded from the on-chain 'from'
replayGuards: a partial unique index (one live intent per commitment)
flows.buyerSurface: PayPanel — 'network fee' language, no ABI/contract/chain-id on the default view (M10.5 §6, §47); the rate hint; the shortened recipient; 'Still checking with the network. You can close this and come back'; a confirmed receipt + explorer link
flows.walletAdapter: src/features/payments/minipay/wallet-adapter.ts — the ONE place a wallet tx is built; lazy-imports viem; no ethers/wagmi
flows.analytics: 11 events (payment_method_viewed → payment_confirmed); 3 forwarded server-side because the buyer often closes the tab before confirmation

payments.nonNegotiable: Intra never custodies funds, never signs/executes the buyer's final supplier payment, and never presents a settlement as real without verification + a real tx hash (BR-001, CLAUDE.md §4.1/4.3)

layers.what: 2 optional append-only events (READY_FOR_PICKUP by the merchant → a 6-char pickup code; PICKUP_CONFIRMED by the buyer via session OR code), both gated on handoffConfirmedAt
layers.notProof: the PROOFLINE_DISCLAIMER is on every surface verbatim: 'operational evidence, not a cryptographic proof, not a payment settlement, not a guarantee'; no public reliability/reputation/on-time score

layers.what: created at the moment of human approval (local + transactional so it can't be lost); publishes handoverCommit = keccak256(code‖salt); the buyer alone gets 'code', the server withholds 'salt'; attested by Intra's own signer to EAS (or a labelled mock) as a separate retryable step

the genuine second signature — the merchant presents the buyer's code, signs EIP-712 typed data with their OWN wallet (must be the payout-address wallet), Intra relays via EAS attestByDelegation; 2-of-2, server as non-signing referee
layers.honestyBound: proves the named parties completed the handover protocol at a time — NOT quantity, quality, timeliness, or satisfaction (ADR-018)

surfaces.public: /evidence — 3 strictly-separated zones (Real results / Demo data / Unavailable & external integrations) + 'What changed from feedback' + CSV/JSON export; every figure a COUNT from existing tables; demo data (a single [DEMO SEED] business) excluded from real numbers; no session ids, no task content, no addresses
surfaces.operator: /operator Metrics (the same report + a content-free 25-event feed); /operator Evidence (a full cross-referenced task trace — DB state + on-chain refs + a consistency cross-check; PROBLEM: leaks raw enums + 'MISMATCH' + schema UIDs)

trustAndEvidence.trustCopyInventory: ~20 verbatim phrases catalogued in 07-TRUST-MONEY-BLOCKCHAIN-UX.md §13 — each is non-negotiable at its current surface

notifications.model: a notification is a CURRENT ATTENTION ITEM, not a log line (the audit trail is the history); one row per (audience, recipientKey, dedupeKey); a repeat event updates the row and re-surfaces it unread
notifications.grouping: ACTION_REQUIRED / TIME_SENSITIVE → 'Needs your attention'; the rest → 'Updates'
notifications.inApp: ActionCentre (GET /api/notifications) on /activity (buyer) + /supplier/:slug (business); opening a row marks it read optimistically and follows its deeplink; reading ≠ acting

push.degradation: any of VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY/VAPID_PRIVATE_KEY/VAPID_SUBJECT unset → push UNAVAILABLE, in-app only, nothing breaks
push.payload: only { title, body, url, tag } — no id, amount, address, code, or secret (ADR-020 §18)
push.delivery: fire-and-forget from notify(); a failed push never fails the domain action; invalid subscriptions (404/410) deleted; repeated soft failures prune after 3
push.levelGate: ACTION_REQUIRED / TIME_SENSITIVE push whenever push is on; INFORMATIONAL / COMPLETED only if notification_preferences.pushInformational
push.binding: a subscription is bound to the SERVER-resolved recipient; a client-sent id is never trusted

notifications.contextualPrompts: PushPrompt + InstallPrompt never fire on first load — only once a person has real async work; dismissal is permanent (localStorage); a denied browser is never re-asked
notifications.deepLinks: sw.js notificationclick focuses/opens a window at deeplink?ref=push → ResumeSignal fires workflow_resumed; a stale business deep link shows a staleNote Callout and rings the target card
notifications.eventMap: verified in specsForEvent — see 05-INTERACTION-STATE-MODEL.md §2.11 for the full event→notification table

mobile.requirement: works at 360px; non-crypto language; real <label>s; keyboard nav; visible focus; associated form errors (NFR-UX-001, NFR-A11Y-001, CLAUDE.md §5)
mobile.breakpoints: ONE — Tailwind sm: (640px); base classes are the mobile layout; md:/lg: only on the landing page
mobile.modals: NONE — no <dialog>, no drawers; every 'modal' interaction is an inline panel, a native <details>, or a component mode switch (consequence: no focus-trap issues; but a mid-flow panel has no dismiss)
mobile.navigation: NO bottom navigation; the 3 buyer surfaces are linked only by in-page pills / back-links
mobile.touchTargets: buttons min-h-9/min-h-11; full-card tappable rows; <input type=checkbox> is size-4 (16px), mitigated by the wrapping <label>
mobile.inputs: text-base (no iOS zoom); inputMode hints (numeric/decimal/tel/email); autoCapitalize off on codes/addresses; datetime-local in QuoteResponseForm is a fiddly mobile picker
mobile.responsiveTests: NONE — jsdom RTL tests do not compute layout; 360px is a manual DoD gate
difficultOnAPhone: OnboardingForm full wizard (15 fields, dead end)

cachePolicy./api/*: network-only, never cached; offline → a clean 503 OFFLINE JSON

serviceWorker.neverCached: prices, quotes, approval, payment, fulfilment, cancellation, handover, permissions
serviceWorker.updatePolicy: install-and-wait; a dismissible 'Update now' banner (ServiceWorker.tsx); ONE reload; never mid-transaction
serviceWorker.notificationClick: focus/open a window at deeplink?ref=push; falls back to postMessage({type:NAVIGATE}) → router.push

pwa.installPrompt: InstallPrompt — never on first load; only when hasAsyncWork; captures beforeinstallprompt; iOS Safari gets a Share-sheet hint; permanent dismissal (localStorage intra.installPromptDismissed)

errorsAndRecovery.ui: ApiError(0, NETWORK); OfflineBanner when navigator.onLine false; SW returns 503 OFFLINE JSON
errorsAndRecovery.recovery: retry when back online; writes are idempotent

errorsAndRecovery.ui: ErrorState 'This request belongs to another device' + 'Start a new request'
errorsAndRecovery.recovery: NONE — localStorage is the only identity

errorsAndRecovery.situation: agent run expired (30 min) / server restart
errorsAndRecovery.ui: requestErrorCopy 'This run has expired… Your request text is still here' + restart
errorsAndRecovery.recovery: restart; the request text is preserved

errorsAndRecovery.situation: agent run taking too long (>120 polls)
errorsAndRecovery.ui: 'This is taking longer than expected… Reload the page to pick the run back up'
silent quiet retry (MAX_RECONNECTS=5) with a 'Reconnecting…' chip

errorsAndRecovery.situation: run ended without a usable quote
errorsAndRecovery.ui: OutcomePanel Unsuccessful + outcomeCopy (NO_PROVIDERS/NO_QUOTES_RETURNED/OUT_OF_SCOPE…) + 'Nothing was ordered and no money moved'
a semantic Callout from describeTaskException (headline / what happened / what to do / what next / money note)
accepting is still allowed; a warning Callout; the message gains a 'reconfirm the price' line
requestErrorCopy APPROVAL_STALE 'The quote changed… Review the current one'
useOrderPayment catches USER_REJECTED → cancels the intent → 'Payment cancelled. Nothing was confirmed.'
wallet-adapter attempts wallet_switchEthereumChain; on failure 'Switch your wallet to the Celo network'

errorsAndRecovery.situation: order-payment verify hiccup (server unreachable after tx sent)
errorsAndRecovery.ui: 'The tx is real and on-chain — this is a reporting hiccup… reopen the order and it will pick up'
3 distinct Callouts; never a receipt; explorer link only on real SETTLED
inline field errors via zodResolver + mode:'onBlur', or server INVALID_BODY fieldErrors flattened onto fields

errorsAndRecovery.situation: route paused between task creation and submit
errorsAndRecovery.ui: submitTask → task FAILED + 409 ROUTE_UNAVAILABLE; RequestForm 'That printer just went offline. Pick another.'
app/error.tsx 'Something went wrong on our side. Nothing you did caused it, and no request was sent to a printer.'

organisingConcepts: the request/task is the buyer's unit of work — everything about one job lives on /tasks/:id, fully resumable from server state
the route is the business's unit of capability — a lifecycle + a 14-day freshness clock
the quote is the only commitment — published prices are guidance; an accepted quote is immutable
the decision is its own step — separate from 'a quote exists' and 'the order was sent'
evidence is layered and never conflated — a payment ≠ a fulfilment record ≠ a quality rating

navigation.buyer: in-page pills + back-links between /agent, /activity, /tasks/:id (no persistent nav)
navigation.public: the reduced Header nav (Home→/agent, For businesses→/supplier/onboard, Docs)

informationArchitecture.navGap: primaryNav lists 7 entries; Header renders 3; /activity, /operator, /evidence, / reachable only by direct URL / in-page links

nonNegotiables.rule: the buyer sends the final WhatsApp order themselves; the pre-filled message is shown in full and never auto-sent
the buyer decision is its own explicit step, with the full offer on the surface, before the contact channel is revealed
the buyer approves the wallet transaction separately from the commercial approval
SETTLED / CONFIRMED only after real verification + a real transaction hash; an explicit UNAVAILABLE/503 state otherwise; no fabricated receipt ever
a settle timeout renders indeterminate, never 'paid'
price/availability data carries a confirmation timestamp and auto-expires at 14 days → stale → unavailable
merchant quote-display consent is an explicit, unbundled tick — never inferred
operator verification (all 6 checks) before a route goes ACTIVE — never defaulted or auto-approved
public wallet address only — never a seed phrase, private key, password, BVN, NIN, card, or bank credential; shown shortened; ownership verified out-of-band
demo / non-persistent state is clearly labelled
the Proofline disclaimer, verbatim, on every Proofline surface; no public reliability/reputation/on-time score
an attestation proves the handover protocol completed at a time — not quantity, quality, timeliness, or satisfaction
the LLM proposes; a human commits the write; the model never holds a tool, never touches the DB; recordBuyerDecision is not model-facing; any model failure falls back to deterministic
Intra never custodies funds; MiniPay is wallet→business direct; the x402 fee is the agent's, capped at $0.05, distinct from the order price
every async surface has explicit loading / empty / validation-error / network-error / success / unavailable states
mobile-first, 360px, real <label>s, keyboard nav, visible focus, associated form errors
MVP scope: flyer printing only; no new vertical, no marketplace, no directory, no escrow, no dispute flow, no reputation score

technicalConstraints.constraint: Next.js 15 App Router + React 19; the 3 /supplier/* pages + /evidence are RSC (force-dynamic); everything else buyer-facing is a 'use client' island fetching JSON
Tailwind 3 + CSS-variable tokens (src/styles/tokens.css — ADR-022 warm-editorial palette; load-bearing per CLAUDE.md §6.1); no CSS-in-JS; no web-font fetch; no dark mode
no component library — 9 hand-rolled primitives; the Callout/StatusPill/DataList vocabulary is deeply wired
Zod schemas are the client/server contract; the model must produce Zod-valid JSON
viem is the only chain library (ADR-018/023) — client-lazy-imported in wallet-adapter; no ethers/wagmi
@anthropic-ai/sdk is server-only — never a browser import
ESLint bans @amplitude/* outside src/features/analytics/; every client surface calls useAnalytics(role); a hand-written 58-event taxonomy
the API envelope { success, data } / { success, error:{ code, message, details? } } and the apiRequest helper
auth: buyer = x-session-id (localStorage); business = x-manage-token / ?t=; operator = x-operator-key (sessionStorage); no accounts
Idempotency-Key on every write; the /v1 quote folds sha256(X-PAYMENT) into the scope
16 DB tables (15 domain + idempotency_keys) with lifecycle invariants (src/lib/db/schema.ts); schema changes via a committed Drizzle migration (ADR-006)
after() keeps background work (agent run, payment verify) alive past the HTTP response — a Vercel Phase D fix; do not remove

env flags that change the UI (all degrade safely): OPERATOR_API_KEYS, X402_API_KEY, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, VAPID_* (3), NETWORK_ENV + ATTESTATION_SIGNER_KEY (gates the MiniPay path to production), NGN_USD_RATE_URL, NEXT_PUBLIC_AMPLITUDE_API_KEY

uxProblems.problem: buyer identity is device-bound with NO recovery — a device switch loses the task + the WhatsApp message about to be sent; the constraint is stated only after access is lost
the full onboarding form collects 15 fields then dead-ends ('email this JSON to an operator'); the operator has no create UI

two parallel buyer entry points (/agent, /request) with different capabilities; /request can't compare providers and is ORPHANED (not linked from anywhere — grep '/request' src); nav 'Home' = /agent not /
/tasks/:id shows 7-8 stacked panels on a HANDOFF_READY task with MiniPay; the current action isn't obvious
x402 PaymentReceipt leaks attributionTag, atomic amounts, CAIP-2 ids, 'via agent payment protocol' on a buyer surface
QuoteResponseForm (highest-frequency merchant task) asks for fixed/range, confidence, datetime-local — precision for a phone user mid-job
two visually identical 'code' boxes (buyer handover code, merchant pickup code) on related surfaces
'Demo only — nothing here is saved' over-prominent and partly false (the task/quote/decision ARE saved)
stale theme colour (#0f3e17 green) in layout.tsx viewport, manifest.ts, opengraph-image.tsx, global-error.tsx
internal pages inherit the new palette but not the new spacing/heading rhythm
EvidencePanel TraceView shows raw enums, attestationMode:'mock', bare 'MISMATCH', schema UIDs — judge-facing
primaryNav lists 7, Header renders 3; /activity, /operator, /evidence reachable only by direct URL / in-page links
the agent console can show two input boxes after a run settles
the pre-filled WhatsApp message shows raw brief keys (size:, full-colour) — the one place the buyer sees un-humanised data
OperatorRouteCard StatusPill shows route.status.replace(/_/g,' ') (near-raw) where every other surface has a plain label
no seeded, clearly-labelled demo path — RequestForm shows 'No printers are live yet' as the likely first-run state
handover attestation requires window.ethereum — a non-crypto merchant cannot use the feature at all

uxStrengths.strength: the trust-copy discipline — ~20 verbatim phrases that front-load every money/consent/verification fear at exactly the right moment
the semantic progress spine + 'who did what' narrative — the best copy in the app ('Printers answer as people, not APIs — this part is genuinely asynchronous')
the approval gate — the full offer on the surface, never behind a disclosure; a consequence-named button
describeTaskException — every failure answers the same 3 questions in plain language, and never invents a financial outcome
MiniPay abstraction — 'network fee', a locked+sourced FX rate, a shortened recipient, CONFIRMED only on a real receipt; no ABI/contract/chain-id on the default view
the 5-bucket work list — no internal status name ever shown; a plain headline + a verb-first action pill per task
one-read-model-per-surface — getTaskView / getSupplierWorkspace / toAgentRunView / listBuyerWork each return exactly what their page renders
honest empty/unavailable states — '/evidence: No real activity recorded yet… that is the honest state, not a bug'; the x402 UNAVAILABLE callout
contextual PWA prompts — never nag; only appear with async work; permanent dismissal
quick-start onboarding — 9 plain fields, the value prop in-flow, category→template hidden, the manage link surfaced with 'Keep this link'
the quote-integrity model — an accepted price is immutable; a change is always a new PROPOSED row the buyer decides on
accessibility baseline — real <label>s, aria-invalid/aria-describedby, focus-visible rings, role=alert/status, status-by-word-and-icon, prefers-reduced-motion guards throughout

unknowns: whether /request is intentionally retired or accidentally orphaned — it is not linked from any nav (both landing CTAs + the PWA start_url point at /agent), yet /request + RequestForm + its tests are live, maintained, non-deprecated code
whether the conversation is meant to feel like AI — classifyMessage is deterministic; the copy reads as an assistant
whether /supplier/onboard/full is supported or vestigial — linked, rendered, tested, persists nothing
how a merchant receives their ?t= link in production — quickStartBusiness returns a manageUrl shown once; no email/SMS delivery in code
whether the themeColor mismatch is intentional (brand green for OS chrome) or an ADR-022 oversight
the intended relationship between the agent-run RecommendationPanel view (with alternatives/ruled-out) and the /tasks/:id RecommendationCard view (one quote's normalisation)
how many providers a real deployment expects — multi-provider fan-out is agent-run-only; /request is single-route; UX_ARCHITECTURE.md F7 flags fan-out as NEEDS-ID
whether the operator surfaces are meant to be judge-facing polished or purely internal — they leak enums; /evidence (also judge-facing) is polished
the target device split — everything is mobile-first, but the operator console reads desktop-oriented
whether /activity is a primary destination or a fallback — only linked from the /agent 'Activity' pill and its own back-link

majorHiddenSystemComplexity: USDC atomic units + ERC-20 ABI + chain switch (MiniPay)
majorFrontendStrengths: the approval gate exposes the full offer
